## Whole-change basis and independence

This is the fresh final whole-change Code Review required by RC-SR-11 and TG-FINAL-01, performed after M1 completion. I reviewed the complete 22-file branch contribution from ca440d8e^ (bd918a74c2035f7e4d068ca7f06f4dd0351c18ef) to 1e7b36e16e49e3cb608d9fe4c928aa6629f57608, including the three proposal drafts, three model amendments, two scoped legacy amendments, complete approved plan and navigation, source removals and follow-up correction, and current stage records. Current live engineering identities are the subjects below. Registry and prior evidence are inspected supporting basis rather than self-invalidating engineering subjects.

The parent authored the proposal integration, Design, plan, implementation and routing contributions; the user supplied substantive proposal direction. This separately delegated nonauthor reviewer made no engineering edits. My earlier independent Design Review is assessment evidence, not authorship; this final review freshly assesses the actual completed diff and cross-layer realization rather than repeating that Design judgment. The separately recorded milestone review informs but does not substitute for this final assessment. Actual contributor separation supports independence.

Current authoritative inputs are proposal-review-r2, design-review-r2 (all five exact members), delivery-review-r1 (the exact primary plan), code-review-m1-r1 and m1-source-cleanup evidence. Fresh context identifies M1 completed, final Code Review ready and no findings or blockers. Earlier proposal/design r1 judgments remain stale on their original subjects. No final success or Verify outcome exists yet, and this review creates neither.

The deleted source identities before removal are ADR-20260810-published-skill-first-validation-architecture.md at sha256:29ade42cf7eef7a4191061b6fd1c276d9d1e5ddbd16fd73e75b37742c6daf26f and component-published-skill-validation.mmd at sha256:73a2b5399f1f2b69e4bbb5a7f4c5b04b2f7487839de164f442df45f5ce08b09d. Their original content was inspected as removal basis; the reviewed current result is absence, not a fabricated live-file subject. The architecture source/navigation rollback basis is 13cb7452. Old judgments retain their original assessed identities and are not made approval of the replacement models.

## Checklist coverage

| Item | Judgment | Concrete basis |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Spec alignment | pass | The adopted implementation follows the merged direction, DES-SR-13/18/21, TEST-SR-08/10/12/14 and SYS-SR-02/04/06/07/08/09. Two exact sources and three exact architecture subsections are removed with current owner links; no entire spec, new model or extra capability is implemented. |
| Test coverage | pass | TG-01 supplies direct original-to-current semantic inspection, TG-02 exact section/link/history proof and TG-03 operational/package dependency disposition. No runtime test or execution mechanism changes, so preserving them with inspected identities is appropriate; no test-count or keyword proxy replaces meaning assessment. |
| Edge cases | pass | Mixed specs retain their explicit operational populations; provisional candidates do not acquire authority; historical citations are distinguishable from live owner navigation. Unknown necessary readers stop removal. The direct missing-source contrast and valid destination checks cover the changed reference boundary. |
| Error handling | pass | Existing write/recovery/identity/containment safeguards are unchanged. The source/navigation slice is recoverable without resetting unrelated files or reviving an old judgment. No new fallback, failure demotion or broad delete operation is introduced. |
| Architecture boundaries | pass | Current System composition points to Design/Test/Skill/Review and Closeout/CLI/Record Format and retained operational sources. Distribution identity production, Installation checks and Release evidence remain separate candidate responsibilities. Existing model owners suffice for this cleanup. |
| Compatibility | pass | Original applicable BND/INT/PRF/T identifiers and old judgments remain meaningful under the precise new-profile-only exception. FU-012 now distinguishes completed Skill adoption, this received slice and remaining execution contracts; other follow-ups remain unchanged. No historical record, release archive or archived Skill original is removed. |
| Security/privacy | pass | Source-only changes contain no credential or personal runtime data, new permissions or external operation. Operational files and package surfaces are unchanged, and no customer installation or publication permission is inferred. |
| Derived artifact currency | pass | Full-range operational diff is empty and 329 operational file identities remain unchanged. Adapter input and npm files inspection confirms these descriptions are not package-generation inputs. Current candidate metadata therefore has an inspected unaffected disposition; no new archive/package pass is claimed. |
| Unrelated changes | pass | Branch breadth consists of the authorized proposal history and current engineering/evidence chain. The three source removals are exact heading scopes; all surviving H3 bodies except allocated navigation and the complete historical follow-on remain unchanged. No other follow-up is altered. |
| Validation evidence | pass | Reexecuted the exact cleanup comparison and full-range whitespace/operational checks; inspected current approved package/plan identities and actual M1 results. Known legacy prose diagnostics and readability advisories are disclosed, not silently waived failures or claimed full-file prose passes. |

## Integrated source and authority assessment

The final source deletion has complete surviving meaning: retained published-skill-first R1–13/R15/16/R21/R24–29 explain canonical integrity, supported-target inventory and declared transformation/byte parity, release composition, deterministic record validation, semantic assessment, local materialization limits, integrity exceptions and prohibited runtime-selection claims. Skill and adopted recording owners supply the transferred local rules. Test's table defines the selected cleanup population and exact R14/R17–20/R22 exceptions, preserving protection, unknown-behavior investigation, meaningful comparison and owned retirement while dropping only irrelevant extra ledger/repetition/measurement obligations. Unselected populations still have their current contract. No required meaning is reduced to a generic preservation promise.

SYS-DEC-04 preserves useful original decisions and alternatives: nondeterministic runtime certification is not package acceptance, relocation alone does not remove complexity, undocumented protection cannot be discarded, and runtime defects remain legitimate issues. The diagram's relationships are covered by current owner tables and operational rules; its old YAML/Markdown recording label adds no necessary current contract. The removed architecture sections duplicate these now-accessible obligations. Current source-list and inline diagram links now reach real model sections, and the current ADR summary is removed. The historical follow-on and original test input citations stay historical without being retargeted. They are not relied on as approval of replacement content.

The receiving owners, scoped legacy amendments and final navigation work together: a reader can identify current responsibility and applicability without reopening the deleted files or interpreting old approvals. The Design's adoption condition remains dependent on successful Verify; implementation does not claim the new policy became effective merely on Design approval. FU-012 no longer promises a mandatory Validation model or incomplete common Skill adoption. It keeps the remaining selector/preflight/cache work and decision ownership open. FU-013/014 and remaining skill adoption are still separate. Provisional System candidate paths do not require files, and absence of a model does not justify discarding necessary specs.

The earlier two proposal drafts are prior basis. Their conflicting preservation/model-selection preferences are explicitly reconciled by the merged primary proposal and its approved r2; current change and plan point to that merged subject. Their continued presence does not create another current implementation programme or approval. Record updates preserve old assessment subjects and current selected package identity. Unchanged engineering after M1 review allows reliance on its proof where applicable; fresh final integrated assessment remains independently performed here.

## Direct proof and limitations

Ran `python /tmp/check-cleanup-result.py`: passed exact source absence, three removed headings, surviving subsection comparison, historical follow-on preservation, new links, 329 operational identities, empty scoped operational diff and no introduced architecture prose diagnostic. I inspected the helper and its original-source baseline rather than treating its summary as a semantic oracle. Architecture prose remains exactly 268 baseline errors and 115 warnings; full-source prose conformance is not claimed. The plan's documented new-prose enforcement and model/boundary checks passed in M1; legacy template-header diagnostics remain explicitly unchanged. Readability advisories are nonblocking observations.

Ran `git diff --check ca440d8e^ HEAD`: passed. Ran `git diff --exit-code ca440d8e^ HEAD -- skills scripts packages dist schemas templates`: passed with empty output. Searched exact retired filenames across current architecture, models, specs, scripts, packages and skills; surviving references are source-qualified displacement entries or historical input/decision citations. Inspected packages/rigorloop/package.json published files and adapter generation's canonical skill/resource/template inputs. No changed package bytes, metadata or dependent archive assertions were found. No runtime, release, hosted CI or customer-install execution is claimed.

The required negative/alternate-path evidence scales to the actual source boundary: a retired path is absent and cannot act as a current owner, new owner links resolve, retained subsections and operational files remain intact, and no operational reader was silently dismissed. This does not prove every future hidden reader or the whole baseline runtime correct. An actual newly discovered consumer or changed engineering subject would require appropriate correction and renewed assessment before reliance.

No material required correction, unresolved owner decision or missing necessary assessment basis remains for final Code Review. This approved final judgment returns to Route for distinct Verify. Verify must independently assess the complete evidence and current applicability and owns success-only explanation and closeout; this review grants no readiness, PR, publication or installation authority.
independence_basis: Separately delegated reviewer authored no engineering, plan, proposal or implementation contribution. Earlier Design review was assessment only. Fresh final review inspects full branch diff and all integrated layers after sole M1 completion; milestone review is not substituted.
